input.goal: Get product teams to adopt Linear Asks for Slack requests
input.audience: Product and engineering leads who triage requests from Slack

output.hypothesis: Product and engineering leads will adopt Linear Asks for Slack requests when shown measurable time savings in triage and evidence that peers at similar-scale companies (40k+ teams) have reduced context-switching and improved request-to-issue conversion rates.

decisions.statement: Prioritize capability and comparison claims (e.g., "Linear Asks converts Slack messages into trackable issues") and keep framing or opinion claims to a minimum.
decisions.rationale: claim_risk shows 34 supported capability claims and 2 supported comparison claims, while 16 framing and 2 opinion claims are only editorial.

decisions.statement: Build posts around the verified workflow: Slack Asks creates an issue, comment threads stay synced, and Triage Intelligence auto-labels and suggests assignees.
decisions.rationale: fact:fact-48, fact:fact-50, fact:fact-52, and fact:fact-39 confirm the end-to-end flow from Slack intake to triaged issue.

decisions.statement: Address product and engineering leads who triage internal requests (bug reports, IT/setup needs) from Slack.
decisions.rationale: fact:fact-64, fact:fact-65, and fact:fact-66 define Linear Asks as designed for internal requests and useful for engineering and IT/support teams.

decisions.statement: Frame Linear Asks as the structured intake layer that turns ad-hoc Slack pings into triaged, prioritized issues without leaving Slack.
decisions.rationale: fact:fact-10, fact:fact-49, and fact:fact-50 show Asks supports Slack intake, converts to issues, and keeps conversations synced.

decisions.statement: Lead with LinkedIn for product/engineering leads; use X for technical deep-dives and community discussion.
decisions.rationale: Hacker News conversations (audience_signals#1, #5, #9) show high engagement from technical audiences; LinkedIn aligns with the brief’s target of product leads.

decisions.statement: Do not claim Linear Asks is available on all plans—note it requires Business or Enterprise.
decisions.rationale: prior_evidence#9 explicitly states Asks is "Available to workspaces on our Business and Enterprise plans."

openQuestions: What are the current LinkedIn and X engagement benchmarks for Linear’s own posts? (No performance rows were provided.)
Which specific Slack-workflow pain points (e.g., lost requests, duplicate issues) resonate most with the target leads?
Are there customer quotes or case studies showing time saved per triaged request?
